name: Dev-via-spec Planner → Reviewer Handoff
description: When the dev-via-spec-planner emits decide(action=planned), the planner has produced a plan ready for completeness review. This rule fires on that signal and spawns the dev-via-spec-reviewer specialist. R3.3 of the ADR-031 phasing — first internal handoff in the dev-via-spec chain.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.dev-via-spec-review
on_enter.prompt: The dev-via-spec planner emitted a plan via decide(action=planned). Planner loop id: $entity.instance (passed as prior_loop_id in your task properties). Call read_loop_result with that loop id to read the plan content (the decide reason field). Apply your completeness checklist per `20-completeness-checklist.md`. If every item is present and well-formed, call decide(action=approved). Otherwise call decide(action=insufficient, reason="<bullet list of gaps>").

metadata.cross_grounding_caveat: The reviewer-as-enumerator pattern in SemSpec lets the reviewer cross-ground the plan against the upstream research artifact. The dev-via-spec-reviewer's checklist would benefit from the same cross-grounding (e.g., 'every artifact seed_requirement is represented by an epic'). Forward-propagating the upstream research_reviewer_loop_id through the dev-via-spec chain requires rule-engine support for property-passthrough that semstreams beta.27 doesn't ship. R3.3 ships with reviewer-evaluates-plan-only as the first-version contract; the reviewer's persona is defensive (checklist works on plan content alone). R3.4 or an upstream rule-engine improvement should add cross-entity property propagation, after which the persona can re-add cross-grounding to the artifact.
